categories.main_business_segments: Jafron Biomedical Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of innovative blood purification medical devices and biomaterials. Its primary product lines include disposable hemoperfusion cartridges, plasma bilirubin adsorption columns, DNA immune adsorption columns, cytokine adsorption columns, hemodialysis concentrates, and blood purification equipment. These products are widely applied in treating uremia, poisoning, severe liver diseases, autoimmune diseases, and multiple organ dysfunction syndrome.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in adsorption material production, including carrier preparation, coating technology, ligand preparation and grafting, and medical-grade purification processes. It has developed advanced resin adsorption technologies for blood purification, including the patented pHA series with specific charge technology for selective adsorption. Manufacturing involves standardized, high-quality, and automated production lines with strict quality control, complying with national Class III medical device standards and international certifications such as EU MDR and CE.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jafron serves hospitals and medical institutions, primarily targeting patients with chronic kidney disease (uremia), severe liver diseases, critical illnesses such as sepsis and acute pancreatitis, and autoimmune disorders. Its products are used in nephrology, hepatology, critical care, and immunology departments. The company also targets emerging markets in metabolic syndrome and health management sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, covering over 6,000 secondary and above hospitals nationwide. It has expanded its international presence with product registrations and clinical applications in over 90 countries, including Germany, Switzerland, the UK, Italy, Spain, India, Russia, Mexico, and Brazil. Its equipment is installed in more than 2,000 overseas hospitals, with growing market penetration in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jafron operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the blood purification supply chain. It independently develops and manufactures core raw materials like HA resin, produces finished medical devices and equipment, and sells directly or through distributors to hospitals. The company controls key raw material synthesis processes and maintains close supervision over suppliers to ensure quality and exclusivity.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in blood purification technologies, focusing on developing new adsorption materials, improving device performance, and expanding product lines in hemodialysis, plasma adsorption, and cytokine adsorption. It pursues both independent and collaborative R&D with academic institutions, aiming to enhance clinical efficacy and broaden applications into new fields such as metabolic syndrome and health management. Digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Jafron generates revenue primarily through the sale of disposable blood purification consumables (hemoperfusion cartridges, adsorption columns), blood dialysis concentrates, and medical devices. Sales are mainly conducted via a buyout distributor model to hospitals, supplemented by direct sales and academic promotion activities. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jafron holds a leading position in the domestic blood purification medical device industry, recognized as a national manufacturing champion and technology innovator. The blood purification sector is still emerging with limited competitors of smaller scale. The company maintains competitive advantages through proprietary technologies, extensive hospital coverage, and strong academic collaborations, positioning it as a dominant player in China and an expanding force internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jafron achieved revenue of approximately RMB 2.68 billion, a 39.27% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 820 million, up 87.91%. The company maintains a high gross margin of over 80%, strong cash flow generation, and a net asset base exceeding RMB 3.3 billion. It has demonstrated consistent growth driven by expanding product sales, market penetration, and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jafron offers innovative, high-quality blood purification products with proprietary adsorption technologies that effectively remove toxins, inflammatory mediators, and protein-bound toxins, improving patient outcomes in chronic and critical diseases. Its products are clinically validated, guideline-endorsed, and supported by extensive academic research. The company differentiates itself through technological leadership, comprehensive product portfolios covering the full blood purification spectrum, and strong service and academic promotion capabilities.
